scenes.voice: JWT or sessions? The real difference is where the state lives.
A session keeps the login state on the server. A JWT carries it inside a signed token.
Sessions are easy to revoke. Delete the record, and that user is logged out.
scenes.code:
sessions.delete(sessionId)
// user is logged out now

scenes.voice: A JWT stays valid until it expires. Logging out early needs extra work, like a blocklist.
One server-rendered app? Sessions are usually simpler. Many services or clients? A short-lived JWT fits well.
Save this for the next time you pick auth.
